description:
Register a third-party MCP server (https, public FQDN only) under
    Viridis Verified. Returns a content-addressed service_id; idempotent on
    (url, provider). fee_minor is the per-verified-call fee in cents.

fee_minor.description: Per-verified-call fee in minor units (cents). Default 2.
fee_minor.title: Fee Minor

payment_ref.description: Optional. A paid credit or payment reference, used only after the free daily calls. Leave it out to use the free tier or a seat.
payment_ref.title: Payment Ref

request_id.description: Optional. Your id for this call. Repeat it to retry safely: the same request_id is never charged twice.
request_id.title: Request Id

url.description: The MCP server's https URL (public host only).
url.title: Url

name: register_service
title: Register service
